item_summary: $300-400 27-inch 4K USB-C IPS monitor with 99% sRGB color accuracy and 65W integrated power delivery
detailed_item_draft: Target a 27-inch 4K UHD (3840x2160) monitor featuring an IPS panel for optimal color fidelity and wide viewing angles. The device must be priced between $300 and $400 USD. Mandatory features include 99% sRGB color gamut coverage with factory calibration and 65W Power Delivery via USB-C for laptop charging. The stand must offer full ergonomic adjustments including height, tilt, swivel, and pivot. Connectivity should support HDMI 2.0 and DisplayPort 1.4, plus a USB hub with downstream USB-A ports. Build quality requires a low-profile design with minimal bezels. Prefer models with flicker-free technology and low blue light modes for eye comfort. A minimum 3-year warranty is required.
